notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in google/guava (v4.2 family): reusing an ImmutableSet.Builder created with an expected size to build additional sets hangs, or misreports elements, because review() shrinks the internal hash table without resetting maxRunBeforeFallback / expandTableThreshold. The observable symptom is an infinite loop in contains() on the freshly built set once the retained table packs 100% full; localisation requires reading the nested builder implementation inside the collection source, so the bug file is deliberately not named. Verifier: provenance (HEAD pinned, every tracked file except the single fixed source byte-identical to parent, no untracked files) + /app/summary.md + the project's own upstream regression test (testReuseBuilderReducingHashTableSizeWithPowerOfTwoTotalElements, extracted from the fix commit at build time into /opt/golden) run under a timeout via the project's JUnit3 harness + 12 of the project's own existing ImmutableSetTest methods + the direct reproduction + three authored hidden cases (different expected sizes, element counts/types and a three-build reuse) with different inputs than the upstream test. Oracle applies an authored two-line patch to the one source file. Java/javac 21, plain javac pipeline (no Maven), 1 vCPU.
